scope: Offline bank reconstruction/readout diagnostic, all77 frozen targets at300s and all3reservoir memory seeds. Exact original prompts/options/gold and actual stored bank membership; only pre-target frames. Reconstruct original pooled values by verified original RGB pairs; re-encoding explicitly allowed OFFLINE. Original latest8/128token outputs, text and privileged snapshot must exactly replay. Uniform8 same read budget, all_bank up to32steps/512tokens is a separately labeled larger-read-budget diagnostic. Not a streaming-memory/latency, equal-budget fullbank method, official benchmark or training result. One frozen PlainLoRA2500; fp32 letter head over bf16 hidden primary, bf16 secondary. No new reserved sources, correctness filtering, audio/subtitles, or post-target frames. Shared offline reconstruction cache is diagnostic infrastructure, not a deployable memory bank.
